headline:

intro: Mobile detailing at your door, 365 days a year. We bring our own water and power, so you don't need to provide anything.

mobile.title: Your driveway is our shop.
mobile.intro: We bring the detail to you, so your day keeps moving.

points.name: At your door
points.text: We come to your home, office or hotel. Henderson, Las Vegas, Primm, Mesquite and Jean.

points.name: Fully equipped
points.text: Our own water and power. You just give us access and space.

points.name: Works around you
points.text: We operate 365 days a year. Same-day slots can be checked 24/7 on our booking site.

points.name: Easy to book
points.text: Call 725-333-4835 or book online. Most details take about 2 to 3.5 hours.

servicesTitle: Inside, outside, and every detail between.
servicesIntro: Four services, one standard: attention to detail. Prices depend on your vehicle's size, condition and needs.

services.name: Silver Detail
services.text: A premium maintenance detail: handwash, tires and wheel wells dressed, door jambs cleaned, interior vacuumed and wiped, windows cleaned.

services.name: Gold Detail
services.text: The full detail. Everything in Silver, plus carpet extraction and steam cleaning of plastics.

services.name: Show-Shine Detail
services.text: The ultimate exterior detail for neglected cars: clay bar, engine bay detail and a premium ceramic sealant.

services.name: Headlight Restoration
services.text: Cloudy headlights brought back to life.

services.name: Paint Enhancement
services.text: An add-on service to bring up the finish of your paint.

services.name: Metal Polishing
services.text: Dull, oxidized metal restored on wheels, fuel tanks, steps, bumpers and bull bars.

why.name: Every detail
why.text: Courtesy, care and attention to every detail on every job.

why.name: Showroom finish
why.text: Our goal is a showroom-quality finish at your doorstep, every time.

why.name: Licensed and insured
why.text: Deep Detailing LLC is licensed and insured, and has served customers since 2023.

whyTitle: The detail is in the name.
howTitle: Book it. We show up. You drive off shining.

steps.name: Request a consultation
steps.text: Call or fill out the form. Consultations are free.

steps.name: Get your quote
steps.text: We price by your vehicle's size, condition and needs.

steps.name: Pick up your car
steps.text: Detailed, protected and ready for the big reveal.
